text:
Maria F.: FYI I found ~USD 21,600 in GPU spend on project `gpu-fleet-prod-sim` with no `team` or `customer` labels. Export attached.
CostBot: Uploaded invoice CSV to s3://billing/2026/05/gpu-fleet-prod-sim-2026-05.csv
Alex B.: Can you paste project + billing account? Ill run a quick BigQuery trace.
Maria F.: project: gpu-fleet-prod-sim, billingAccount: BA-7782. Dates look like Apr 24-30 concentrated.
Ben H.: That project runs our nightly simulation batch. We recently switched to a shared managed instance group and I think the autoscaler created instances without the label because of a rollout bug.
Priya S.: Finance note: we can reclassify internally but require a signed owner confirmation and manager approval for >$10k. Maria, can you split the invoice lines by day and resource id?
Maria F.: Done  daily breakdown attached. Bulk on Apr 27-29. Also ran `bq query` to map usage: `SELECT resource_id, SUM(cost) FROM `billing.gce_usage` WHERE project_id='gpu-fleet-prod-sim' GROUP BY resource_id;`
Alex B.: I also checked live instances: `gcloud compute instances list --project=gpu-fleet-prod-sim --format="table(name,labels)"` returns many with empty labels. Opening infra PR to auto-inject labels from instance template.
Ben H.: Confirmed these map to nightly-sim job owned by platform-research. I'll send a signed confirmation email to finance and retro-tag logs where possible. We cannot retro-apply labels in GCP billing, but we can tag our internal ledger.
Priya S.: Once we have Ben's owner confirmation, propose split: mark $18,000 to platform-research cost center, $3,600 to the customer-eng sandbox (they were using small subset). Need @Sam G. approval for >$20k reallocation.
Sam G.: Approve provisional allocation: up to $22k internal reallocation (REF: FIN-PROV-1795012345). Finance to record provisional entry and track vendor adjustments if any.
CostBot: Alert rule created: "untagged-gpu-fleet-5k-day" -> INC-4197. Ticket TICKET-FIN-9090 created and linked.
Maria F.: I'll create ledger entries, attach Ben's confirmation email and Sam's approval in the ledger. Priya, please add a budget rule to prevent unlabeled GPU spikes going forward.
Priya S.: On it. Creating Budget: project filter `gpu-fleet-prod-sim`, rule: block/alert if unlabeled GPU spend > $5k/day. Linking to #finance and #eng.
Ben H.: Will deploy the instance-template fix this week and add an org policy to reject untagged GPU instances.
Maria F.: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as the audit trail for the manual reallocation and infra remediation. :white_check_mark:
